# Floe Protocol Documentation

> Floe is an intent-based peer-to-peer DeFi lending protocol on Base. Borrowers and lenders express their terms as intents, and solver bots match compatible pairs to create fixed-rate, fixed-term loans.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.floelabs.xyz): Overview of Floe — structured credit and financing on Base
- [Quick Start](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Get started with Floe in 5 minutes
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/getting-started/core-concepts): Intents, LTV, oracles, grace periods, markets, credit scores, and more
- [How to Lend](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/user/lend): Earn interest by lending USDC or USDT to borrowers
- [How to Borrow](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/user/borrow): Borrow USDC or USDT using WETH or cbBTC as collateral
- [Risk & Liquidations](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/user/risk-liquidations): How liquidation works, protection mechanisms, oracle system
- [Credit Scores](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/user/credit-scores): On-chain credit scores via Cred Protocol
- [Using LendrBot AI](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/user/lendr-ai): AI assistant for natural language DeFi interactions
- [Architecture](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/protocol/architecture): Smart contract architecture, intent/loan lifecycle, loan terms, upgradeability
- [Intent Auto Matching](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/protocol/orderbook-matching): Compatibility rules, fill amounts, solver mechanics, token flows
- [Oracles & Circuit Breaker](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/protocol/oracles-conditions): Chainlink + Pyth dual oracle, failover, circuit breaker triggers
- [Flash Loans](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/protocol/flash-loans): Uncollateralized atomic loans, flash arbitrage via Aerodrome
- [Security](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/protocol/security): Audit status, bug bounty, governance
- [Run a Solver Bot](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/developers/run-solver-bot): Set up and run an intent matching bot to earn fees
- [Run a Liquidation Bot](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/developers/run-liquidation-bot): Monitor loan health and execute liquidations for profit
- [AgentKit Integration](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/developers/agentkit): 23 AI agent actions via Coinbase AgentKit — TypeScript and Python SDKs
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/developers/agentkit-typescript): @floe/agentkit-actions — Vercel AI, LangChain, MCP, OpenAI integrations
- [Python SDK](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/developers/agentkit-python): floe-agentkit-actions — LangChain, OpenAI integrations
- [Agent Working Capital](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/developers/agent-working-capital): Credit facility actions for autonomous AI agents
- [Contract Addresses](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/developers/networks): Base Mainnet and Sepolia contract addresses, tokens, markets, RPC providers
- [FAQ](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/faq/general): Common questions about borrowing, lending, intents, liquidation, fees
- [Glossary](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/glossary): Key terms — APR, LTV, intent, oracle, circuit breaker, ERC-1271, flash loans
- [Changelog](https://docs.floelabs.xyz/docs/changelog): Version history — v1.0.0 through v1.3.0
